title: Father Bernard Vaughan
html_source:
Bernard Vaughan was an English Roman Catholic clergyman, brother of Herbert and John Stephen Vaughan.
Born: 1847, Herefordshire, United Kingdom
Died: 1922
Education: Stonyhurst College
Books: Sinless Mary and Sinful Mary
